newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 2c to 619c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 2c to 619c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose 2.0 cents to 619 cents a kg clean on Tuesday in Melbourne, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were mixed, with the 19 micron indicator slightly dearer and 20/22m slightly cheaper.
The 21m indicator was 1.0 percent dearer, 23m 0.5 percent cheaper and 24/25/26m 0.5 percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 27m was 1.5 percent dearer, 28/29m 1.0 percent cheaper, 30m 0.5 percent cheaper and 31m unchanged.
In cardings, lambs were unchanged, washing locks 2.0 percent cheaper, carbonising 1.0 percent dearer and crutchings generally unchanged, WI said.
WI said Japan and China were principal buyers with good support from Taiwan and most sectors of the trade.
Of the 10,956 bales offered, 1.5 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 36,000 bales to be offered.
